The foot melting (severity 2) is also consistent with the visual evidence; the toes lack distinct separation from the substrate. alignment_reasoning: The Fine-Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class (Nile Crocodile) with high confidence, establishing strong semantic alignment. The score is penalized from a perfect 5.0 due to these missing fine-grained anatomical details, placing it above the 'mid' reference (4.29 alignment) but below a flawless specimen.

These are typical AI generation weaknesses in high-frequency detail areas. The rest of the body (scutes, tail, general shape) is clean.
